items.event_time_ist: Reuters piece published Oct 14, 2026 (Washington ET); Reuters/Ipsos poll published Oct 12, 2026
items.summary: Betting on the US midterm elections has surged this year on Polymarket and Kalshi, prediction markets that rose to prominence in 2024. Piece flags insider-trading and integrity concerns: Kalshi has suspended a handful of candidates for betting on their own races; ACDC researcher Michelle Kendler-Kretsch says election prediction markets focus 'a disruptive new financial technology on our democratic process'; Kalshi counters that markets help reveal accurate information and that it blocks election trades by politicians and campaign workers. A new Reuters/Ipsos poll published Monday (Oct 12) found most Americans oppose using prediction markets to wager on elections. Single-sourced (wire only - carried only by wire-copy republishers, no second outlet in a different lean category).
items.title: Reuters: midterm betting surging on Polymarket/Kalshi; most Americans oppose election wagering
